'''Halven''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Halven was the brother of [[Tarzen Tagge]], the owner of the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]. At Halven's suggestion, Tagge attempted to locate and [[Mining/Legends|mine]] resources, to grant TaggeCo its own supply chain.<ref name="GoI" />
